title: Technology Research Institute, Wuhan Textile University
content: Aerogel University Research Platform. The Technology Research Institute at Wuhan Textile University is a university research platform supporting advanced materials and technical innovation. Its official research coverage includes porous aerogel membranes for filtration, making it relevant for aerogel-related materials research and application development.
